_comment: Workflows the agent enrolls affiliates into. Public API can enroll but not create; build once in the GHL UI / Orgo desktop (or `ghl workflows create --experimental`) using EXACTLY these names. Each email/SMS step should end with 'update contact field Last Touch Date = today'. Copy lives in knowledge/funding/05-conversation-playbook.md; newsletter/event/offer copy is read from custom values.

onboarding.name: FAM · WF-1 Onboarding Drip
onboarding.steps: Day 0 welcome email + SMS (how to submit a deal, who their manager is) → Day 2 'your first deal' guide → Day 5 SMS check-in → Day 9 training invite → Day 14 'how's it going?'

biweekly_touch.name: FAM · WF-2 Bi-Weekly Touch
biweekly_touch.steps: One message on the channel NOT used last time (branch on Last Touch Channel): value tip / partner win / quick question.

monthly_offer.name: FAM · WF-3 Monthly Offer
monthly_offer.steps: Email with {{custom_values.monthly_offer_subject}} / {{custom_values.monthly_offer_body}}; SMS teaser 1 day later; update Last Offer Date.

dormant_reactivation.name: FAM · WF-4 Dormant Reactivation
dormant_reactivation.steps: Day 0 personal-style email 'still in the funding game?' → Day 3 SMS → Day 7 new-program email → Day 14 'should I close your file?' breakup.

dead_reactivation.name: FAM · WF-5 Dead-Lead Reactivation
dead_reactivation.steps: Quarterly 3-touch campaign: what's new at 7FF → free growth-service offer → breakup. Reply → notify manager.

event_invite.name: FAM · WF-7 Event Invite
event_invite.steps: Invite email+SMS with {{custom_values.next_event_title}}, {{custom_values.next_event_date}}, {{custom_values.next_event_link}} → reminder 24h → reminder 1h → replay link after.

reply_router.name: FAM · WF-9 Reply Router
reply_router.steps: Trigger: customer replied → internal notification to assigned manager + tag 'fam:needs-triage'. The agent triages within the hour.
